title: Launch distance to P
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance from launch point to P as a function of m, v0, q, E, using kinematics in the electric field and the given 30° angle.

title: Magnetic field range
description: Essential: Correctly determines the allowed range for B in terms of m, v0, q, l, based on geometric constraints for exiting between Q and N.

title: Minimum trajectory distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum distance to baffle MN when exiting at QN's midpoint, expressed in terms of l.

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: Applies constant acceleration equations to find vertical displacement and velocity at P, linking time, acceleration (qE/m), and the 30° condition.

title: Magnetic circular motion geometry
description: Important: Uses geometry of the baffles and the particle's entry/exit conditions to determine the minimum and maximum radii of the circular arc.

title: Lorentz force centripetal relation
description: Important: Applies qvB = mv²/r to relate magnetic field strength, velocity, and radius of curvature.

title: Velocity at magnetic entry
description: Important: Correctly computes the particle's speed upon entering the magnetic field using the 30° angle and v0.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets the angle (e.g., using 60° instead of 30° for trig relations) or the direction of forces/deflections.

title: Geometric constraint oversight
description: Pitfall: Fails to consider both the minimum and maximum radius constraints needed for the particle to exit between Q and N.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of final expressions for distance, B-field, and length.
